Kill the [[Flame Keeper]]s in the [[Eastern Frontier]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Find the [[Charr]] fires northeast of the [[Frontier Gate]]. Kill the Flame Keepers and extinguish the flames.
* Return to Captain Arne for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* [[Inscribed Staff]]: 
** [[Chaos damage]]: 4-7 (req. 3 [[Domination Magic]]) 
** +4 [[Energy]]
** +3 Energy (while health is above 80%) 
** +3 Energy (while health is above 60%) 
** +3 Energy (while health is above 40%)
* [[Sundering]] [[Long Sword]]: 
** [[Slashing damage]]: 10-14 (req. 3 [[Swordsmanship]])
** [[Armor penetration]] +10% (Chance: 10%)<sup>1</sup>
** [[Damage]] +15% (vs. [[hex]]ed foes)
#Can be [[salvage]]d

==Walkthrough==
Start from Frontier Gate heading northeast. Soon you can find several Flame Keepers. After eliminating them you can travel back to Ascalon City for your reward.

==NPCs==
;Foes
[[Charr]]
*{{e}} 7 (23) [[Flame Keeper]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Captain Arne
:''"Our troops at the Frontier Gate report a concentration of Charr near [[The Great Northern Wall|the Wall]]. They have spotted columns of smoke that suggest the Flame Keepers have set up an altar there. The Flame Keepers' altars serve as a source of power for the Charr and must be destroyed if we wish to hold the [[Great Northern Wall|Wall]]. Since the King's Army refuses to venture north of the Wall, I need a volunteer to lead a sortie northeast and destroy the Flame Keepers."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take care of it.
| decline = I'm sorry. I have other things I must do.
| ask = The fires still burn and the Charr grow more powerful while we speak! Time is not on our side. Gather a party immediately and travel to the Frontier Gate, then head northeast to the Charr camp. Hurry!
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Captain Arne
:''"Excellent work extinguishing the Charr's fires. Without their altars, they lose much of their power. The army won't venture north of the Wall, so it falls to the Vanguard, and volunteers such as yourself. Your assistance won't be forgotten."''

==Notes==
* The 10/10 Sundering [[Sword Hilt]] can be salvaged from the Long Sword.
